forehead.line: My fan was folded up and grazing my forehead
stanza: My cheeks were reflecting the longest wavelength
My fan was folded up and grazing my forehead
And I kept touching my neck to guide your eye to where
I wanted you to kiss me when we find some time alone

forehead.line: Through tons of sewage, fate written on their foreheads
stanza: Let it burn, let it burn, let it burn, burn, burn
Some dove in the river and tried to swim away
Through tons of sewage, fate written on their foreheads
Blood, blood, blood, blood and fire
Let it burn, let it burn, let it burn, burn, burn
Date palms and orange and tangerine trees
And eyes are crying for everything
Blood, blood, blood, blood and fire
Let it burn, let it burn, let it burn, burn, burn
